title: A Swiss family, 25 November
subtitle: The family's week on one page
note: An example family: it owns a machine-making company that sells to Germany and the United States, rented apartment buildings near Zurich, and a portfolio in francs, euros and dollars. No amounts were given and none are needed. UBS Switzerland AG stands in as its custody bank because it is well known; nothing is alleged. Every finding is an Antevo engine's answer on the date shown.

tries.label: What the family owns and relies on, one by one
tries.source: Antevo Strategy Radar, Antevo Research (strategy desk), Antevo Companies and Antevo Guard, 24 to 25 Nov 2026. One of Guard's four sources, the certificate logs, did not answer.

items.name: The family company
evidence: German business sentiment rose again in November (Ifo 90.6 from 90.1) and the manufacturing survey stood at 55: firmer orders for suppliers to German industry
Washington is reported to be readying higher tariffs on the EU and others; rates and dates are not published. A US tariff floor of 15% has applied to Swiss exports since 14 November 2025
Swiss industrial production grew 0.8% on the year in the third quarter of 2026, against 4.0% expected

items.name: The property
evidence: The SNB's next assessment is on 10 December 2026; Swiss inflation rose to 1.5% in October
A rise would lift the cost of SARON-linked loans on the buildings; rent, in francs, does not move with the currency
Supply near Zurich stays scarce; a forecast for 2027 sees prices up 2.0% in Zurich, well below recent years

items.name: The portfolio
evidence: A euro bought 0.9131 francs on 25 November, down 2.2% over a year; a dollar 0.8342 francs, up 3.4%
The gap between the SNB's rate (0.00%) and the Fed's (3.88%, October 2026) is about 3.9 points: roughly what it costs to hedge dollars into francs
Swiss ten-year yield 0.51% (September 2026), up from 0.30% a year earlier

items.name: The custody bank
evidence: UBS Switzerland AG, CHE-412.669.376, Zurich: active; direct parent UBS AG, ultimate parent UBS Group AG (GLEIF, 27 October 2026)
Not found on the OFAC, EU, UK and SECO lists, read 25 November 2026; 16 register notices this year, all changes of signatories, the latest on 19 November
ubs.com has been registered since 15 February 1993; nothing contradicts the record in the three sources that answered

steps.label: For the family meeting, with the links

items.do: When the US tariff rates and dates are published, check whether the company's own product codes are on the list
items.why: Until then the plans are reports; the board's trigger is publication plus the company's own codes.

items.do: Put 10 December in the diary and list which loans on the buildings are SARON-linked
items.why: The SNB's assessment is the one date that touches the company, the property and the portfolio at once.

items.do: Ask the bank which currencies in the portfolio are hedged, and what the hedge costs
items.why: With a rate gap of about 3.9 points, hedged and unhedged dollars are two different holdings.

items.do: Ask the company for order intake from Germany since September
items.why: Sentiment is firmer and output is not: the order book says which one the company is living in.

items.do: Watch the companies the family relies on
items.why: At most one alert a day if a register notice or a sanctions list changes.

items.do: Before a new payee is paid, check it and confirm the account by phone
items.why: A capital call, an invoice or a change of account by email is where a family is most exposed.

sections.title: The week in markets
sections.so_what: The reported plans name the EU; whether Swiss goods are included is not known until the list is published. For this family the channel to watch is the company's German customers.
evidence: Chip makers gave back most of Monday's rally in a session while retailers rose on strong US consumer confidence
The same day brought reports of higher US tariffs on China, the EU, Japan, South Korea and others
Freight shows no rush to land goods ahead of them: 57 ships waiting off Los Angeles and Long Beach in the week to 24 November, against 56 in the four weeks before

sections.title: What could go wrong
sections.so_what: Two of the three reach this family directly: tariffs through the company, the AI trade through the portfolio. The third, the Gulf, reaches it through energy and freight.
evidence: New tariffs on the largest trading partners: rising, high impact, medium probability, on the radar for 22 mornings
AI suppliers lose their second bid: rising, high impact, medium probability, 53 mornings
The Gulf truce frays at sea and in Riyadh: rising, high impact, medium probability, 16 mornings
sections.source: Antevo Executive Brief, risk radar, 25 Nov 2026

sections.title: The next three months
sections.so_what: One event moves the three holdings in different directions: a franc surge cuts the company's euro revenue while franc assets hold their value. Seeing them on one page is the point.
evidence: The base: tariffs stay near today's level, the SNB moves once in December or March, the euro holds between 0.91 and 0.93 francs
A franc surge on a market shock, the euro towards 0.88 to 0.89 francs: the most damaging for the company, since a 5% rise in the franc takes 5% off euro revenue in francs
A dollar and rate overshoot, the dollar towards 0.88 to 0.90 francs: dollar revenue and assets gain in francs, US bond prices fall
The desk holds the base with lower conviction than usual; a euro below 0.90 francs is its signal for the second

sections.title: Market strain
sections.so_what: Prices are moving more than usual: anything that has to be bought, sold or refinanced on a fixed date is worth a second look at its timing.
evidence: Week of 20 November 2026: elevated, down from high (3.8 times) the week before
Bonds, commodities and volatility are breaking at more than twice their normal rate; credit is calm at 0.5 times
Provisional: 697 of 753 pairs were read this week. It describes, it does not forecast
sections.source: Antevo Tremor Index, week of 20 Nov 2026

links.text: German sentiment is firming while Swiss industrial output slowed to 0.8% growth: the company's order book will say which of the two it is living in.
Tariffs reported on the EU would reach the family through its German customers even if Swiss goods are untouched.
The base scenario is held loosely while markets run at 2.4 times a normal week: the franc-surge scenario needs only one shock.
The bank is on the register, on none of the lists read, and nothing contradicts its domain record: a clean routine check. The phone call before a new account is paid still applies.

watch: The published rates and start dates of the US tariffs
Euro-area inflation for November on 1 December (consensus 4.3% after 4.0%)
US payrolls for November on 4 December
New register notices for the bank (Antevo Companies alerts at most once a day)
The next Tremor reading on Saturday
